about_the_game:
🌙 Night Market Simulator: Build and Grow Your Own Night Market! 🌙

Are you ready for a real night market experience?
Night Market Simulator is a detailed and fun simulation game where you build and expand your own market, make strategic decisions while buying and selling products.

Open your store, stock the shelves, meet customer needs, unlock new products with licenses, and grow your business by managing your employees!

📘 About the Game

Night Market Simulator offers players the chance to build, manage, and grow their own night market in a deep trading simulation.
In a buy-and-sell system, price your products strategically, meet customer demands, and grow your business!

▪ License System:
Sell products, level up, and unlock new product licenses. Each license means more items and more profit!

▪ Warehouse and Stock Management:
Receive products in boxes, transfer them to storage, stock up, and create an organized system by filling your shelves.

▪ Employee Management:
Hire workers like cashiers, stock movers, and shelf organizers. Increase automation and use your time efficiently!

▪ Expandable Store:
Use your earnings to expand your store, unlock new areas, and showcase more products. Bigger space means more customers!

▪ Different Shelf Categories:
Set up your store with various product placement types like freezers, refrigerators, shelves, and fruit stands.

▪ Dynamic Pricing and Profit-Loss Calculation:
Set your own product prices, adjust profit margins, and optimize your business with smart trading strategies.

▪ Store Customization:
Give your store a name, personalize its look, and reflect your unique style!

🎮 Game Modes and Content

▪ Free Play:
Play at your own pace and develop your business however you want.

▪ Missions and Objectives:
Complete specific tasks to earn rewards and progress through guided goals.

🤝 Community and Development Process

Night Market Simulator is a game shaped by community feedback.
Each update brings new content, improvements, and additions based on player suggestions.
Your ideas matter to us!

short_description: Start your market from scratch, choose and price your own products. Every sale leads to new licenses, bigger spaces, and exciting new opportunities. Take full control of your warehouse layout, manage your staff wisely, and lay the foundation for your very own market empire!
